title: thesilentascend script
features: Teleports to essences. (you can change the teleport speed after the task.wait)
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local visited = {}

while task.wait(0.4) do
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v.Name == "Essence"
                and v:IsA("BasePart")
                and v.Parent
                and not visited[v] then

                visited[v] = true
                character:PivotTo(v.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                task.wait(0.4)
            end
        end
    end

    -- Clean up entries for removed objects
    for part in pairs(visited) do
        if not part.Parent then
            visited[part] = nil
        end
    end
end
